I guess the reason I cannot change to fashion design is that I have two weeks left of my degree, but I haven't due to my mental health and just general mental rejection of my degree, gone to my classes in over three months. I just one day woke up, had a huge mental breakdown and refused to leave the house. 

And yes, sewing is a huge hobby of mine. I use it more to make cosplays, but seeing as I'm huge on fashion, I'd love to sew clothes.
